arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Lamken argued Congress enacted the PMPA to regulate specific actions.
He stated the law targets termination and non-renewal.
Mr. Farraher argued the jury found Shell engaged in prohibited conduct.
He claimed Shell raised rents to force dealers out of business.

paragraphs: The case tests the scope of the PMPA. Dealers argue rent hikes count as termination. Shell argues the law requires a formal end to the contract.

paragraphs: The outcome defines the scope of federal franchise protection. It determines whether dealers can sue over economic pressure. It clarifies the boundary between state contract law and federal regulation.
